subject: Website Preview and Final Review
body_snippet:
Dear Tim,

My name is Phil and I look after accounts and delivery at AZ Web Corp - I
will be your point of contact from here on, so anything you need, reply
straight to this email.

Your website is nearly complete and ready for your review. You can view it
without creating an account or signing in at:

  https://ymemon.github.io/tim-ness-carpentry-preview/

Please review the design, wording, services, contact information, and
service areas. We will also need your preferred project photographs to
replace the temporary concept images, along with any corrections or
additional business information you would like included.

Once we receive your feedback and photographs, we can complete the final
updates and prepare the website for its official launch.

Kind regards,

--
